instruction: Warehouse With Office Annex Summary This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio one-story warehouse with an office annex and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv. 1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv with size at least 10 bytes. 2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10. 3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 1 OS:BuildingStory, 2 OS:Space objects, and 2 OS:ThermalZone objects. 4. The OS:Space names are exactly Warehouse-Hall and Office-Annex. 5. Every OS:Space references the OS:BuildingStory, references an OS:ThermalZone, has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes, and has floor area greater than 0.05 m2. 6. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set. 7. The model has exactly 13 OS:Surface objects: 2 Floor surfaces, 2 RoofCeiling surfaces, and 9 Wall surfaces. 8. The surface Outside Boundary Condition counts are exactly 2 Ground, 9 Outdoors, and 2 Surface. 9. The model has exactly 1 OS:SubSurface object, it is a FixedWindow, and its area is included in the office zone window total. 10. The surface geometry bounding box has X span 42.00 m, Y span 32.00 m, and Z span 5.00 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m. 11. The sum of floor surface areas is 1104.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 12. The sum of exterior wall gross areas is 711.20 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 13. The total fixed-window area is 11.52 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2. 14. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly the header row zone_name,floor_area_m2,ext_window_area_m2,use_type and 2 data rows in this order: Office Zone and Warehouse Zone. 15. Each /home/user/Desktop/result.csv floor_area_m2 and ext_window_area_m2 value matches the evaluator-computed totals for that thermal zone with tolerance +/-0.20 m2; use_type is exactly office for Office Zone and warehouse for Warehouse Zone. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
